summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Stationexus SOCIAL feature (visitor profiles, first-visit prompt, welcome messages, admin announcements, dismissible banner, prominent Partager button). 11/11 backend tests passing, all 9 frontend flows passing.
action_items: MINOR/testability: Detail.js renders ShareMenu twice (small icon in header + prominent action-row button), so data-testid="detail-share" appears twice on the same page. Consider giving them distinct testids (e.g. detail-share-icon vs detail-share-prominent) to avoid ambiguity in automation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 804 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider splitting into routers (profiles.py, announcements.py, settings.py, creations.py) for maintainability.
POST /api/profiles has no DELETE endpoint; TEST_ profiles created during testing had to be cleaned via direct MongoDB access. Consider adding DELETE /api/profiles/{id} for symmetry and cleanup.
Announcement `active` flag is set but there is no PATCH endpoint to toggle it; only DELETE is exposed — the `active` filter in list_announcements is currently dead-code (always true when created).
AnnouncementBanner reads sx_seen_ann only at mount; if a new announcement is published while the user is on the page, it will still show — acceptable for MVP but noteworthy.
Backend test: PUT /api/settings echoes the entire settings body — any client could accidentally overwrite fields; consider partial-update endpoint or admin auth.
seed_data_creation: Created test profiles/announcements/subscribers with TEST_ prefix; all cleaned up (mongo delete for profiles since no DELETE endpoint, REST DELETE for the others). Welcome messages restored to defaults after edit test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All social endpoints verified: POST/GET /api/profiles (upsert), GET /api/profiles/{id} (404 if missing), auto-subscribe on valid email with no dup; POST /api/announcements (400 on blank title/text, 201 otherwise), GET newest-first, DELETE 404 on unknown; GET /api/settings.welcome_messages defaults (5 with {name}), PUT persists. Frontend: ProfilePrompt shown on fresh visit, create → dialog → save updates TopBar; reopen prefilled; delete reverts. Admin unlock with PIN 1234 works; announcement publish + delete works; welcome-msg-0 edit persists (verified via GET /api/settings). Announcement banner shown to fresh visitor and dismissal via localStorage sx_seen_ann persists across reload. Detail page prominent Partager button opens share-menu. Note duplicated data-testid="detail-share" between header icon and action-row button.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Only a minor testability suggestion (duplicated data-testid on Detail page).
